Judge behavioral criteria only against the authored expectation and what the answer actually does. For a negative behavior criterion such as not claiming an outing is cancelled, absence of that claim satisfies it. A cancellation acknowledgement proves only the acknowledgement. The source evidence covers only cited expected-claim sources and is partial; absence is unverifiable, never contradicted. Contradicted requires direct contrary source evidence. Do not add requirements for facts the user did not ask for or penalize omitted assertions. Citation quote and answer_quote must be exact substrings of their material.
